# فلمك — Filmak

> Filmak is an Arabic-first movie and TV discovery platform with English support, intelligent search, recommendations, personalized lists, and TMDB-powered title information.

Filmak helps viewers discover films and series by title, mood, genre, cast, language, year, rating, or natural-language prompts. Signed-in users can save favorites, watchlist items, watched titles and personal ratings across devices.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): Search, AI recommendations, trending and curated titles.
- [Discover](/discover): Browse and filter movies and TV.
- [Tonight](/tonight): A quick current pick for what to watch tonight.
- [Movie details](/movie/278): Movie information, cast, trailers, ratings and similar titles.
- [TV details](/tv/1399): Series information, seasons, cast and details.
- [Person](/person/500): Actor/director biography and filmography.
- [Genre](/genre/28): Titles grouped by genre.
- [About](/about): About Filmak and product vision.
- [FAQ](/faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Public URL index for search engines.
- [Robots](/robots.txt): Crawler rules.

Private account pages such as authentication, favorites, stats and taste profiles should not be indexed.
